title: Decide ParticipantListUpdate apply semantics
description: protocol-06 §7.5 leaves apply semantics open (wg mimid-1wgh.37.48): index basis for removedIndices relative to role changes, shifting, out-of-range/duplicate indices, duplicate users. Needs a decision before whoever applies participant_list updates (hub room state / agent) is built. Codec in .5.3 does not apply updates.
